muraPolicy.writeBoundary: No live operation is permitted. Any future write requires exact target/build/programmer qualification; two independent bounded reads with matching SHA-256 for both abl and devinfo; unit binding; explicit destructive authorization; mandatory restore and readback of both partitions; token/serial redaction; and an owner-selected reset/restore order.

confirmations.prompt: This procedure is unqualified test-only machine data. It cannot authorize loading a programmer, writing, erasing, or changing security state.
Unlock and factory reset erase userdata. Confirm a separate user-data backup and explicit acceptance of loss.
Confirm both ABL and devinfo backups are from this exact unit, have two matching SHA-256 reads, and both will be restored and read back.
Choose reset-before-restore or restore-before-reset. Source order conflicts; this procedure selects neither.
